title: Tool Mapping
description: Forensic tool, configuration, and SOLVE-IT method-planning guidance. Every investigative step names a versioned tool (or AnalyticTool) and, when planned, a SOLVE-IT technique.
mission: Make tool provenance and method selection first-class so later reviewers can reproduce what the lab actually did.

Tool.notes: Tool is the instrument, never the evidence. Prefer ConfiguredTool when flags or rulesets matter.

recipe_skeleton.summary: Investigation + versioned Tool/ConfiguredTool + InvestigativeAction (+ optional SolveitInvestigativeAction).
steps: Create Tool or ConfiguredTool with name, version, and configuration entries.
Optionally record a SOLVE-IT objective or technique via SolveitInvestigativeAction.
Create InvestigativeAction with instrument, object, and result.
Do not attach FileFacet to the Tool.
